fr.short: Concept central des Three Ways of DevOps : optimiser le flux de travail du dev à la production
fr.full:
Le **Flow** (flux) est le **First Way** des Three Ways of DevOps : optimiser flux de travail de dev vers production pour livraison rapide et continue.

**Principe** : éliminer gaspillages, réduire taille des lots (batch size), limiter WIP (Work In Progress), rendre travail visible.

**Pratiques** : CI/CD (automatisation pipeline), trunk-based development (intégrations fréquentes), feature flags (découpler déploiement et release), value stream mapping (identifier goulots).

**Métriques** : Lead Time (idée → production), Deployment Frequency, Change Failure Rate.

**Origine** : inspiré du Lean Manufacturing (Toyota Production System) et Theory of Constraints (Goldratt).

en.short: Core concept of the Three Ways of DevOps: optimizing the workflow from dev to production
en.full:
**Flow** is the **First Way** of the Three Ways of DevOps: optimizing the workflow from dev to production for fast, continuous delivery.

**Principle**: eliminate waste, reduce batch size, limit WIP (Work In Progress), make work visible.

**Practices**: CI/CD (pipeline automation), trunk-based development (frequent integrations), feature flags (decouple deployment from release), value stream mapping (identify bottlenecks).

**Metrics**: Lead Time (idea → production), Deployment Frequency, Change Failure Rate.

**Origin**: inspired by Lean Manufacturing (Toyota Production System) and the Theory of Constraints (Goldratt).
